Keep these notices with the binary. Copying linux-amd64/gum without this
directory drops the license condition.

Gum itself is MIT. Copyright (c) 2022-2024 Charmbracelet, Inc.
The copyright and permission notice that shipped in the release archive is
LICENSE in this directory.

The binary is statically linked. licenses/ holds the license file from the
root of each Go module in Gum 2.0.2's module list. Those files are MIT or
BSD-3-Clause. BSD-3-Clause requires that copyright, conditions, and
disclaimer to stay with a binary distribution. None of those modules added
a separate NOTICE file.
